WITH spatial_projects AS (
  SELECT ss.domainregistry, p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial ss
  INNER JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
counts_per_source AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    COUNT(*) as source_count
  FROM spatial_projects
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(source_count) as total_count,
    AVG(source_count) as avg_count
  FROM counts_per_source
)
SELECT 
  cps.fundflux as funding_source,
  cps.source_count as count,
  CAST(cps.source_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share,
  cps.source_count - t.avg_count as excess
FROM counts_per_source cps
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE cps.source_count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY cps.fundflux
